summary: All 7 phases of the /email staleness detector redesign completed and verified live: both Gmail and Logos reach [ok] under the new file-vs-file + bounded-tolerance + reindex-marker gate, with the cross-repo census.nix/mbsync.nix edits written (not built/committed) for the user to review and deploy.

follow_up_recommendations.title: 22 unindexed Logos files (independent notmuch indexing anomaly)
follow_up_recommendations.detail: 22 files in ~/Mail/Logos/cur since 2026-07-06 are absent from the notmuch index; two email-reindex runs (incl. one after forcing mtime forward) did not index them. new.ignore and hardlink/inode dedup ruled out. Root cause not identified. See implementation summary for full diagnostic dead-ends already ruled out.

follow_up_recommendations.title: email-census / wrapper binaries silently discard positional --account argument
follow_up_recommendations.detail: Only `--account <val>` works; a bare positional account arg is silently ignored. Root cause is the shared frozen lib.nix mkPreamble arg-parsing loop, affecting all five wrapper binaries plus email-census. Deliberately deferred to preserve scope discipline around the frozen preamble.

cross_repo_notice: census.nix and mbsync.nix in ~/.dotfiles were edited (Edit tool writes only). No home-manager switch, nixos-rebuild, nix flake check, or git commit/push was run in ~/.dotfiles. The user must review, rebuild, and commit/push there at their own discretion, then re-verify the deployed email-census output for both accounts.
